findings.claim: Coinbase 正申請 SEC 核准代幣化股票，對零售券商形成競爭壓力；IBKR 已讓部分美國客戶以穩定幣入金（與 tastytrade 同用 ZeroHash 基礎設施）
findings.source: Stocktwits: Interactive Brokers Turns to Stablecoins To Compete With Robinhood, Schwab, Coinbase
findings.excerpt: Both tastytrade and Interactive Brokers rely on ZeroHash for underlying infrastructure.

findings.claim: Motley Fool 評論：IBKR 已有全球券商平台、清算、保證金與機構網路，穩定幣與代幣化對其是增量服務而非全新商業模式
findings.source: Motley Fool: interactive brokers advantage coinbase robinhood
findings.excerpt: Unlike many crypto-native companies, Interactive already operates a large global brokerage platform, clearing system, margin platform, and institutional trading network. Stablecoins and tokenization become incremental services layered onto an existing business rather than entirely new business models.

findings.claim: 零佣金交易使定價壓力成為結構性，IBKR 雖未以免費為品牌仍處於此環境
findings.source: Motley Fool: Can Interactive Brokers Maintain Its Edge in a Changing Brokerage Industry?
findings.excerpt: Even though Interactive Brokers never built its brand on being "free," it still operates in an environment where pricing pressure is structural.

note: 未找到取代 IBKR 核心技術的明確替代方案；多為評論性來源，非公司文件。最新 10-K 風險因子未取得（搜尋只回舊年度）。
